# AgentsBar

A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks AI coding-provider usage windows, credits, costs, and resets across 63 providers — Codex, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, LiteLLM, and more.

Canonical documentation:
- AgentsBar — every AI coding limit, in your menu bar: https://agentsbar.app/ - A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks AI coding-provider usage windows, credits, costs, and resets across 63 providers — Codex, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, LiteLLM, and more.

Source: https://github.com/johanvillalbab/agentsbar
